clusters.name: Mainstream Middle Class
clusters.description: Moderate annual income ($40k-$70k) with moderate spending score (40-60). The steady retail backbone.
clusters.marketing_strategy: Deploy family weekend specials, seasonal catalog launches, loyalty points rewards, and popular brand deals.

clusters.name: Frugal Affluent (Savers)
clusters.description: High annual income ($70k-$137k) with conservative spending (1-40). Wealthy but value-driven.
clusters.marketing_strategy: Target with quality assurance, durable products, premium warranties, investment-grade items, and prestige value.

clusters.name: Carefree Spenders
clusters.description: Modest annual income ($15k-$40k) but high spending score (60-100). Youthful trendsetters and impulse buyers.
clusters.marketing_strategy: Promote trendy apparel, limited edition pop-ups, buy-now-pay-later (BNPL) financing, and social media flash sales.

clusters.name: High-Value VIPs
clusters.description: High annual income ($70k-$137k) with high spending score (60-100). Prime targets for premium services.
clusters.marketing_strategy: Invite to exclusive loyalty clubs, VIP concierge, private product previews, and luxury brand collaborations.

clusters.name: Sensible Budget Savers
clusters.description: Modest annual income ($15k-$40k) and conservative spending (1-40). Economically prudent shoppers.
clusters.marketing_strategy: Offer bundle savings, discount coupons, loyalty cashback, clearance promotions, and essential product lines.
